target.statement: Annual median (x̃) tropospheric NO2 column for Guayaquil canton in 2020, reported as 1.41 ×10⁻⁵ (Table 1, Guayaquil row, x̃ column, 2020).
target.dataset: Sentinel-5P/TROPOMI Level-3 OFFLINE tropospheric NO2 column, Guayas Province, Ecuador, 2020–2025, accessed via Google Earth Engine

compute.basis: The target is a single canton-year median from a public GEE collection; the main cost is re-implementing the GEE export/reduction pipeline (the linked GitHub page is a project page, not a runnable config) and downloading/processing one year of TROPOMI NO2 over Guayas, which is small enough for a laptop CPU.

blockers: No runnable code/configs linked (only a project webpage), so the GEE pipeline must be re-implemented from the paper text
Exact GEE collection ID, QA masking, monthly outlier-removal details, and canton boundary handling are underspecified
Requires a Google Earth Engine account and internet access to GEE
title: Tracking Urban Atmospheric Pollutants using Sentinel-5P Satellite Data
